import gzip, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
p=Path('evaluation/evidence/reviews/a2-rpc-20261106')
sha=lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
rows=json.loads((p/'commands.json').read_text())
for row in rows:
 assert row['exitCode']==0 and not row['timedOut']
 packed=Path(row['log']).read_bytes()
 assert sha(packed)==row['compressedSha256']
 assert sha(gzip.decompress(packed))==row['outputSha256']
selection=json.loads((p/'regression-selection.json').read_text())
assert len(selection['selected'])==2273 and len(selection['excludedLiveFixture'])==206
assert sum('test_rpc_binding_view.py::' in n for n in selection['selected'])==26
assert sum('test_rpc_binding_view_live.py::' in n for n in selection['excludedLiveFixture'])==7
assert not any('test_rpc_binding_view_live.py::' in n for n in selection['selected'])
log=gzip.decompress((p/'isolated-regression.txt.gz').read_bytes()).decode()
assert '2072 passed, 201 skipped, 206 deselected in 42.25s' in log
before=json.loads((p/'inputs-before.json').read_text())
after=json.loads((p/'source-after.json').read_text())
assert after['sourceEntriesUnchanged']==len(before['sourcePins'])==434
assert after['localInputsUnchanged']==len(before['localInputs'])==248
for name,digest in before['helperPins'].items(): assert sha((p/name).read_bytes())==digest
probes=json.loads((p/'probes.json').read_text())
assert probes['controlCount']==15 and probes['propertyProbeCount']==12 and len(probes['acceptanceGaps'])==8
for row in probes['rows']:
 if row['classification']=='control': assert row['expected']==row['actual']
for label in ('quantity normalization gap 0x-1','quantity normalization gap 0x+1','quantity normalization gap 0x 1','negative latest block'):
 assert next(r for r in probes['rows'] if r['label']==label)['actual']=='REFUSE'
peer=json.loads((p/'communication-provenance-final.json').read_text())
assert not peer['missingBranches']
assert not any(r['ambiguous'] or r['divergentRevisions'] for r in peer['files'].values())
result=dict(recordedAt=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),commandsVerified=len(rows),
 sourceCommit=before['sourceCommit'],sourceEntries=434,localInputs=248,
 inventorySha256=sha((p/'inputs-before.json').read_bytes()),
 isolatedPass=2072,schemaSkips=201,deselected=206,newRpcTestsIncluded=26,
 excludedNewLiveTests=7,independentControls=15,propertyProbes=12,acceptanceGaps=8,
 refutedNegativeAndWhitespaceProbes=4,communicationPaths=len(peer['files']),
 sourceAfterSha256=sha((p/'source-after.json').read_bytes()),
 probesSha256=sha((p/'probes.json').read_bytes()),ownerRuntimeReady=False,
 ownerLiveAndMutationResultsIndependentlyRerun=False,executionAuthorized=False,
 fGate='NOT_RUN',gGate='LOCKED',immutableChecks=after)
(p/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
